column4: With effect from Apr 2007, Total Broadband Subscriptions (i.e. for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) includes retail xDSL, cable modems, leased line Internet, 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots access (including Wireless@SG subscriptions).  With effect from Jan 2019, Total Broadband Subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) includes retail xDSL, cable modem, leased line Internet, 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wireless@SG subscriptions.  Provision of Broadband Internet access services via cable modem has ceased since 2020.  Data for Oct 2022 was incomplete due to incomplete data returns from operators.  Data for Oct 2023 exclude one Wireless@SG Operator' figures due to server maintenance.  With effect from Nov 2024, Total Broadband Subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) includes retail xDSL, leased line Internet, 4G/LTE, 5G, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wireless@SG subscriptions.  3G Broadband Subscriptions have ceased from Nov 2024.

Telecommunications, Monthly: Total Wireless Broadband Subscriptions, At End Of Period
column4: Prior to Jan 2019, Total Wireless Broadband Subscriptions includes all retail broadband Internet access subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) provided via wireless platforms such as 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots (including Wireless@SG subscriptions).  With effect from Jan 2019, Total Wireless Broadband Subscriptions includes all retail broadband Internet access subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) provided via wireless platforms such as 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wireless@SG subscriptions.  From Jan 2018, the Wireless@SG subscriptions will only include active users for the month.  Provision of Broadband Internet access services via cable modem has ceased since 2020.  Data for Oct 2022 was incomplete due to incomplete data returns from operators.  Data for Oct 2023 exclude one Wireless@SG Operators' figures due to server maintenance.  With effect from Nov 2024, Total Broadband Subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) includes retail xDSL, leased line Internet, 4G/LTE, 5G, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wireless@SG subscriptions.  3G Broadband Subscriptions have ceased from Nov 2024.

column4: Total Optical Fibre Broadband includes residential and corporate subscriptions to broadband Internet services using optical fibre networks, including end-to-end optical fibre broadband subscriptions that are offered via passive optical network ('PON') and Active Ethernet.

Telecommunications, Monthly: Total Subscriptions Using Other Broadband Internet Access Platforms
column4: From Nov 2010 to May 2011, the Total Broadband Subscriptions using other Broadband Internet Access Platforms included Fibre Broadband Subscriptions.  With effect from June 2011, this indicator will exclude Fibre Broadband Subscriptions.  Instead, Fibre Broadband Subscriptions will be reflected under a new and standalone indicator known as 'Total Optical Fibre Broadband Subscriptions'.
